result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall; only minor cosmetic issues were found, mostly related to horizontally scrolling content being clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row ('Trattoria Piccola') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, which is expected for a carousel but the clipping is abrupt with no partial peek hint of the next card's title or an affordance indicating scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Ensure enough of the next card is visible to hint at horizontal scrolling, or add a scroll indicator (e.g., dots) below the carousel.

issues.description: The category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, and a partially visible chip) are also clipped at the right edge with no visible indication that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Show a partial sliver of the next chip or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate scrollable content.

issues.description: The notification badge on the bell icon is small and relies solely on a red dot to convey unread state, which may be missed by users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider making the badge slightly larger or including a count.
